note: Implementation evidence on a draft branch, not a READY record. Results come from tests/Calor.Compiler.Tests/Interpolation/InterpolationTargetTypingTests.cs. Surfaces: cli = the ConversionOptions that `calor convert` builds with no flags (ConvertCommand.BuildCSharpToCalorOptions); mcp = MCP calor_convert with only `source`. Each C# row is converted, compiled by Calor with effect enforcement off (EnforceEffects = false, the --permissive-effects comparison mode the R0 baseline used), and Probe.Run() of the generated C# is compared with the original. The default-compile column records whether the converted output also compiles with effect enforcement on.
